lesson: Molecular bonding from a physical perspective
title: The Lennard-Jones potential
caption: V = 4ε[(σ/r)¹² − (σ/r)⁶]: steep repulsion at short range, weak attraction further out. Setting dV/dr = 0 gives the equilibrium separation r₀ = 2^{1/6}σ = 1.122σ, where the well depth is ε.
alt: Potential energy against separation: a steep wall below 1 sigma, a minimum of minus epsilon at 1.12 sigma, rising towards zero at large separation.
description: Separation in units of σ; energy in units of ε.
The minimum is at r₀ = 2^{1/6}σ = 1.1225σ, with V = −ε.
At r < σ the (σ/r)¹² repulsion dominates; beyond r₀ the −(σ/r)⁶ attraction fades.
